AXIOM · qeva:1:schema-replacement@1

Schema of replacement

The image of a set under a definable single-valued correspondence is a set.

editorialset-theory · foundations

PLAIN

The idea

The image of a set under a definable single-valued correspondence is a set.

EXACT

The compact statement

For each formula φ(x,y,p̄), if φ is functional on A, then ∃B∀y[y∈B↔∃x(x∈A∧φ(x,y,p̄))], with the usual schema conditions.

EXAMPLE

Applying a definable successor construction to every member of a set produces a set of successors.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

Functionality and the exact schema conditions matter; replacement is not an arbitrary collection rule.

ASSUMPTIONS

  • The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

PROVENANCE

Original QEVA orientation record. It is a compact map entry, not a substitute for a textbook or primary source.
